description: White canvas; grey rounded box top-centre with serif text 'Q. How long would it take for people to notice their weight gain if the mean radius of the world increased by 1cm every second? (Assuming the average composition of rock were maintained.)' and '- Dennis O'Donnell'; large stick figure at left holding a sheet of paper; whiteboard at right with grey-fill globe.
Tiny stick figure appears standing on top of the globe on the whiteboard (single activity frame).
Same composition: question box, large stick figure with paper, whiteboard with globe and tiny figure on top.
Black outward-pointing arrows appear in a ring around the globe; tiny figure on top sits slightly higher (globe pushed outward).
Question box, large stick figure, whiteboard with globe ringed by outward arrows and tiny figure on top.

Hard cut at 10.67s to full-frame red card: black dinosaur-on-satellite graphic upper-centre, white text 'xkcd's what if? THE VIDEO SERIES'; the dinosaur graphic changes pose near 12.25s; at the last activity frame (12.67s) a hard cut to a whiteboard scene (stick figure with hand at chin, whiteboard with globe, no question box). Exact title onset and internal graphic frames beyond samples UNRESOLVED.
White canvas; stick figure at left with hand on chin; whiteboard on a table with eraser/marker tray; plain grey globe on the board. Question box gone.
Plain globe replaced by cutaway globe showing concentric grey layers (crust to core) with a wedge removed; figure and board unchanged.
Figure with hand at chin; whiteboard with cutaway globe (core layers visible).
Ring of black outward arrows appears around the cutaway globe.
Figure, whiteboard with cutaway globe and ring of outward arrows.

Whiteboard and table redrawn in perspective as a tilted/cracked slab with several black crack lines and a gap on its lower edge; globe now sits low with arrows; figure redrawn upright with an exclamation mark above its head. Single frame; whether the board is a camera or redraw change is UNRESOLVED.
Stick figure with '!' at left; tilted cracked board/table with cracks and gaps; globe with arrows in middle.

A rectangular inset picture (black and grey landscape with a jagged rift; small red circular 'what if?' logo bottom-left) enters from the right edge and grows to cover the right-centre of the canvas over ~10 frames; the figure and cracked board remain behind it.
Cracked board/globe scene with the black-and-grey rift inset image (red 'what if?' logo bottom-left) overlapping the right-centre; figure with '!' at left.
Hard cut to white canvas with a black banner at top reading 'T = 1 SECOND' and a lone stick figure standing on a ground line.
Banner 'T = 1 SECOND'; lone standing stick figure centre; ground line across the bottom.

229-frame run, onsets UNRESOLVED between samples: figure jolts into a flinch pose with motion ticks and '!' at 23.96s then returns to standing; banner changes to 'T = 2 SECONDS' by 25.88s; hard cut by 31.54s to a vignette (door at left, stick figure walking a dog on a leash, tree at right, grass) with no banner; hard cut by 33.46s to 'T = 1 DAY' banner with a landmark scale row (CADILLAC MOUNTAIN, EIFFEL TOWER, EMPIRE STATE BUILDING, BURJ KHALIFA) over a faded grey duplicate row.
Banner 'T = 1 DAY'; black-ink landmarks upper row (CADILLAC MOUNTAIN, EIFFEL TOWER, EMPIRE STATE BUILDING, BURJ KHALIFA) on a ground line; faded grey duplicate row below.
A vertical line grows upward from the grey lower row to the ground line of the upper row, then a label '+ 864 m' appears beside it, across 8 frames.
'T = 1 DAY' landmark rows with vertical arrow labelled '+ 864 m' between grey lower row and black upper row.
Hard cut to 'T = 1 DAY' banner with stick figure standing on a thin scale platform, head bowed, with '70kg' in black handwriting at right.
Banner 'T = 1 DAY'; figure on scale; '70kg' right of head.
Red diagonal strike drawn through '70kg' at 42.08s, then red '70.01 kg' written beneath it by 42.17s.
Figure on scale; '70kg' struck in red; red '70.01 kg' below.
Hard cut to a full-frame black silhouette street scene (no banner): four streetlamps, an arched wall with a white arch opening, bushes, a tree; white sky.
Black silhouette ground with four streetlamps, arched stone wall with white arch, a tree at right-centre.
Small white dashed crack lines appear in the arch and its keystone region; arch top slightly displaced.
Silhouette street scene with cracked arch.
A white-outlined stick figure with one arm extended appears in the lower-left over the black silhouette ground.
Silhouette street scene; white-outlined stick figure lower-left gesturing right.
Hard cut to plain white canvas with one black-ink stick figure at lower-left, arm extended to the right; silhouette scene gone.
White canvas; stick figure at lower-left reaching right; no other objects.
Grey-fill globe (Africa/Indian Ocean view) with a black rope band and bow tied around it appears upper-right.
Stick figure at left; large globe with rope tied around it (bow lower-right) upper-right.

Hard cut to a long horizontal rope on posts: a black-haired stick figure lifts the rope near its middle with motion ticks, a bald figure kneels/crouches at right holding a post; rope slopes up at left.
Rope held by black-haired figure centre; crouched stick figure at right; Y-shaped posts along the rope.
Over 3 frames both figures stand upright and the rope becomes level, raised slightly across the frame.
Level rope on posts; black-haired figure at left-centre with hand at the rope; bald stick figure standing at right.
Label '6.28m' with a curved leader line appears above the black-haired figure.
Rope scene with '6.28m' label and leader near the black-haired figure.
Hard cut to a grey globe with a thin double ring and a curved arrow labelled 'C' (left) and a separate 'C' at right.
Grey globe with ring labelled 'C'; separate 'C' to the right; white background, no banner.
Globe group moves up/left, a radius arrow labelled 'r' appears inside it and the text 'C = 2 pi r' replaces the lone 'C' (single frame).
Globe with circumference ring 'C' and radius arrow 'r'; text 'C = 2πr' right.
Equation updates to 'C = 2π(r+1)'.
Globe diagram; equation 'C = 2π(r+1)'.
Second line '= 2πr+2π' appears under the equation.
Globe diagram; 'C = 2π(r+1)' and '= 2πr+2π'.
Red '~6.28' appears under the equation lines.
Globe diagram; equation lines in black and red '~6.28'.
Black banner 'T = 1 DAY' appears at top; over ~7 frames the ring 'C', radius arrow and the equation text fade out leaving only the plain globe.
Banner 'T = 1 DAY'; plain grey globe at left; nothing else.
A thin black rope/equator line with small knot appears across the globe and text 'C ~40,000 km' appears at right (single frame).
Banner 'T = 1 DAY'; globe with equator line; text 'C ~40,000 km'.
Line '+2π · 864m' added beneath 'C ~40,000 km'.
Globe; text 'C ~40,000 km' and '+2π · 864m'.
Line '=5.4km' added.
Globe; three text lines ending '=5.4km'.
Red '0.01%' with red underline appears under '=5.4km'.
Globe; text lines ending in red underlined '0.01%'.
Ring of small black silhouettes of landmarks/buildings (bridge, Eiffel-like tower, others) appears around the globe's rim.
Globe ringed by black landmark silhouettes; text lines with red '0.01%'.
Hard cut to full-frame black ground silhouette desert scene (no banner): cactus left, white car (side view) centre, tumbleweed and cacti right.
Black ground desert silhouette; detailed white car centre; cacti and tumbleweed.
Label 'LOS ANGELES' with a grey map pin appears above the car.
Desert scene; car with 'LOS ANGELES' pin label above.

Hard cut at 90.33s to white canvas with a lattice tower at bottom-centre and two black satellites top-left and top-right joined by dashed lines to the tower; over 7 frames red concentric signal rings appear at the tower top.
Tower with red signal rings; two satellites with dashed lines; ground line near bottom.

Over 128 frames the ground line rises up the canvas, the tower and red rings drift upward with it, while a faded grey copy of the tower base remains below; satellites stay roughly fixed. Continuous drawing animation, no cut.
Ground line high on canvas; tower with red rings above it; grey faded tower base below; satellites with dashed lines.
Hard cut to a room-clock scene: wall clock upper-left, digital clock '03:00.' and small mantel clock on a table, stick figure at right.
Table with digital clock '03:00.' and small clock; wall clock; stick figure at right with hand at wrist.
A tall grandfather pendulum clock appears between table and figure.
Room with wall clock, digital clock, mantel clock, tall pendulum clock and stick figure.
Red label '+3 SECONDS' with curved leader to the pendulum clock appears, plus a black '?' above the figure's head.
Clock room; red '+3 SECONDS' label and '?' above the figure.
Hard cut to banner 'T = 1 MONTH' and a globe with a vertical black divider line, left half grey-fill.
Banner 'T = 1 MONTH'; globe with vertical divider.
Globe and vertical divider differ slightly between the first (108.79s) and last (108.96s) activity tiles (divider extent/globe edge); UNRESOLVED what changed.
'T = 1 MONTH' globe with vertical divider, left half grey.
Text 'RADIUS: +0.4%' appears right of the globe.
Globe with divider; 'RADIUS: +0.4%'.
Second line 'GRAVITY: +0.4%' added.
Globe; 'RADIUS: +0.4%' and 'GRAVITY: +0.4%'.
Third line 'MASS: +1.2%' added.
Globe; three lines RADIUS +0.4%, GRAVITY +0.4%, MASS +1.2%.
Hard cut to diagram: 'Fg ~ r' text upper-centre; small circle labelled 'm' below with tiny stick figure on top and radius arrow 'r'.
'Fg ~ r'; small circle with figure, arrow 'r', label 'm'; banner 'T = 1 MONTH'.
Larger circle with tiny figure on top, centre dot and larger 'm' appears to the right.
Small and large circles; larger one has a centre dot, no radius arrow yet.
Radius arrow with 'r' appears from centre dot to the figure in the large circle (low-energy single frame).
Both circles with radius arrows 'r'; 'Fg ~ r'.
Caption '(THE DIRTY DETAILS: Fg = m/r^2 AND m~r^3, SO Fg ~ r^3/r^2 = r)' appears along the bottom; circles shift up slightly.
Two circles with radius arrows; 'Fg ~ r'; bottom parenthetical caption of formulas.
Hard cut to stick figure on scale at left, '70kg' struck in red with red '70.28 kg' beneath; banner absent in this tile.
Figure on scale; struck '70kg' and red '70.28 kg'.
Hard cut to two side-by-side panels separated by a vertical line: left same figure with '70.28 kg' labelled NOVEMBER; right figure with struck '70kg' and red '71.14 kg' labelled DECEMBER.
Two-panel NOVEMBER 70.28 kg / DECEMBER 71.14 kg.
Hard cut to three panels, each a figure on a scale: '70kg', '70.19kg', '70.35kg' (black ink), no city labels yet.
Three panels with '70kg', '70.19kg', '70.35kg'.
Labels 'SINGAPORE', 'NEW YORK', 'HELSINKI' appear under the three scales.
Three scale panels labelled SINGAPORE / NEW YORK / HELSINKI with 70kg / 70.19kg / 70.35kg.
Hard cut to a full-frame detailed black-line stone viaduct with arches spanning the frame; cliff edges at bottom corners; no banner.
Stone arch viaduct, intact.
Small crack marks appear on the deck near the centre of the viaduct (low-energy single frame).
Viaduct with a small crack at centre deck.
Viaduct redrawn with large breaks in the deck at left and right-centre; piers tilted and falling debris dashes.
Viaduct with broken deck gaps and tilted piers.
Hard cut to a three-storey house on a hillside with a staircase, tree at right.
House on a slope with stair; tree right.
Thin vertical stilts/pylons appear holding the house's underside above the slope.
House on stilts over the slope; tree right.
House redrawn with a large crack splitting the roof and facade, windows displaced, ground cracked.
Cracked house on stilts with split facade; tree.
Hard cut to banner 'T = 1 YEAR' and a globe with a vertical divider line.
'T = 1 YEAR' globe with divider.
Text 'GRAVITY: +5%' appears right of the globe over ~21 frames (first visible at 150.96s).
Globe with divider; 'GRAVITY: +5%'.
Second line 'RADIUS: +5%' added.
Globe; 'GRAVITY: +5%' and 'RADIUS: +5%'.
Small stick figure on a scale appears at lower-right with '70kg' struck in red and red '73.6 kg'.
Globe with two text lines; small figure on scale lower-right with red 73.6 kg.
Hard cut to black silhouette street with banner 'T = 1 YEAR': tilted power poles with sagging wire, streetlamps, collapsed arch with white opening.
Silhouette street; leaning poles; broken arch.
A burning satellite with smoke trail appears upper-right, falling.
Silhouette street with falling flaming satellite upper-right.
Hard cut back to the clock room (wall clock, digital clock, mantel clock, pendulum clock) with stick figure and speech bubble 'YUP, THE EARTH IS DEFINITELY EXPANDING'.
Clock room; speech bubble 'YUP, THE EARTH IS DEFINITELY EXPANDING'.
Red '+5 DAYS' with curved leader to the pendulum clock appears.
Clock room; speech bubble; red '+5 DAYS'.
Hard cut to banner 'T = 5 YEARS' and globe with vertical divider.
'T = 5 YEARS' globe with divider.
Over 12 frames text 'GRAVITY: +25%' appears right of globe while the globe's right half swells outward past its original outline (grow animation).
Globe with enlarged right half; 'GRAVITY: +25%'.
Hard cut to a figure on a scale with struck '70kg', red '88kg', and speech bubble 'IT'S DEFINITELY BECAUSE THE EARTH IS EXPANDING...'.
Figure on scale; red 88kg; speech bubble.
Hard cut to a close view of a collapsed viaduct: broken arches, tilted piers, debris, no figures.
Collapsed viaduct fragments.
Red horizontal arrows appear at bottom-left (pointing left) and bottom-right (pointing right).
Collapsed viaduct with red outward arrows left and right.
Hard cut to black skyline silhouette with a tall tower; small white downward arrow inside the tower.
Skyline silhouette; tower with white short down arrow.
The white arrow in the tower lengthens (low-energy single frame).
Skyline; tower with long white down arrow.
Groups of thin grey arrows (wind) appear sweeping left to right across the tower.
Skyline; tower with wind arrows.
Skyline redrawn with tower collapsed into a broken stump and rubble; wind arrows gone.
Ruined skyline silhouette with shattered tower.
Hard cut to banner 'T = 10 YEARS' and a globe with divider, ringed by a dashed outline with cloud-like blobs (atmosphere).
'T = 10 YEARS' globe with atmosphere ring.
Text 'GRAVITY: +50%' appears at right and the globe's right half swells outward over 18 frames.
Globe with enlarged right half; 'GRAVITY: +50%'; atmosphere ring.
The atmosphere ring (dashed outline and cloud blobs) is redrawn larger around the whole globe (single frame).
Globe with larger atmosphere ring; 'GRAVITY: +50%'.

Hard cut to a two-panel split with no banner: left small black ground silhouette with small arrows around 'AIR PRESSURE' and clouds; right larger ground with large arrows around 'AIR PRESSURE'; dashed sky line.
Split air-pressure diagram; small arrows left, large arrows right.
Hard cut to banner 'T = 40 YEARS' with small globe and divider; over 12 frames the right half swells to many times the size of the left half.
Divider; small left half of globe, huge right half.
Text 'GRAVITY: +300%' appears on the large globe half; view scaled so the right half fills the frame.
Large half globe; 'GRAVITY: +300%'.
Hard cut to a hunched figure with a walker and motion ticks, red '210kg' with arrow, tall leaning cracked building with door at left; ground line.
Figure with walker; red '210kg'; tall building at left.
Fallen trees/logs and a broken stump appear on the ground at right and middle.
Walker figure, red '210kg', building, logs and stump.
Hard cut to split frame with banner 'T = 100 YEARS': left '1G' with standing stick figure and tiny dot (insect); right '6G' with large globe edge and a stick figure lying flat on the ground.
1G side: standing figure and tiny bug; 6G side: prone figure under globe.
Speech label 'HI!' appears next to the tiny insect near the prone figure's head.
Split 1G / 6G; insect saying 'HI!' beside the prone figure.

Hard cut to a full-frame technical chart: x-axis 'OXYGEN BREATHING (HOURS)', y-axis 'OXYGEN PRESSURE (ATMOSPHERES)', labelled zones 'CENTRAL NERVOUS SYSTEM TOXICITY', 'PULMONARY TOXICITY', 'NO TOXICITY FOR LIMITED EXPOSURE', 'NO TOXICITY'; no banner.
Oxygen toxicity chart with hatched and grey zones.
Hard cut to banner 'T = 100 YEARS' and a grey-background arched dome with a figure lying in a bed, a fan at left and fan/vent at right.
Dome with prone figure in bed; fan left.
A humanoid robot holding a tray appears beside the bed.
Dome; figure in bed; robot with tray at bedside.

Hard cut at 240.0s to an unbannered diagram: small circle with radial arrows, arrow, and a dot. Over ~11 s the circle grows slightly, labels 'RADIUS INCREASES DENSITY = CONSTANT' and 'DENSITY INCREASES' appear (visible by 246.96s), and the last activity frame (251.58s) is a hard cut to a blank whiteboard scene with a stick figure. Exact onset frames UNRESOLVED.
Whiteboard blank; stick figure at left with arm extended toward the board.
Labels 'EARTH' and 'EXPANDED EARTH' with a small circle and a large circle (radial arrows) appear on the board.
Board: 'EARTH' small circle and 'EXPANDED EARTH' large circle with radial arrows; figure pointing.
The large circle is replaced by a small inner circle surrounded by a dashed ring and fine radial lines.
Board with EARTH circle and EXPANDED EARTH dashed ring with spikes.
Red strike drawn through 'EXPANDED EARTH' and red 'WHITE DWARF' written beneath; the ring moves slightly left.
Board; 'EXPANDED EARTH' struck, red 'WHITE DWARF'; dashed ring.
Over 4 frames the figure's arm drops to a hand-at-chin pose and the dashed ring collapses to a small circle with short radial ticks.
Figure with hand at chin; board with a small circle with arrows beside EARTH; red WHITE DWARF label.
Red 'CHANDRASEKHAR LIMIT' label with leader and a red dashed circle appear; the circle is enlarged with inward arrows.
Board with larger circle, red dashed ring and 'CHANDRASEKHAR LIMIT'.
Red strike through 'WHITE DWARF' and red 'BLACK HOLE' added; the circle is replaced by a starburst of radial lines around a dot.
Board; EARTH circle; starburst 'BLACK HOLE'; figure with hand at chin.
Hard cut to a black space scene with banner 'T = 300 YEARS': grey-white Earth centre-left, white moon upper-right, three satellites with trails.
Black space; Earth, moon, three satellites with faint trails.
Over 34 frames Earth enlarges slightly and drifts down while satellite and moon trails shift; no cut.
Black space; Earth lower-centre; moon and satellites at original spots.
Large grey spiral lines (solid and dashed) appear winding in toward Earth.
Earth with spiral lines; moon and satellites at outer positions.
Moon and the three satellites are redrawn at positions much closer to Earth along the spiral.
Earth with spiral; moon upper-right near it; satellites close around.
Red arrows appear pulling at the moon from both sides and the moon surface darkens with red dots.
Moon with red tidal arrows near Earth; spiral lines.
White dashed ring around Earth and label 'ROCHE LIMIT' with leader appear.
Earth, dashed ring, 'ROCHE LIMIT' label, moon with red arrows.
Spiral lines, satellites, ring and label vanish; moon redrawn upper-left with a trail of fine white debris dots.
Earth with moon at left and thin debris arc; banner 'T = 300 YEARS'.
Moon redrawn at lower-left breaking up, debris dots now form a loose ring around Earth.
Earth with debris ring and jagged moon remnant lower-left.
White-outlined stick figure with both arms raised appears at left and the debris is replaced by dense white concentric rings around Earth.
Black space; stick figure with arms up; Earth with ring system.

Hard cut to the red end card: dinosaur-satellite graphic at left, 'GET THE BOOKS: xkcd.com/books' with four book covers, credits column at right (Randall Munroe, Henry Reich, Lizah van der Aart, Ever Salazar, Know Art Studios).
Red end card: dinosaur-satellite graphic left, four book covers under 'GET THE BOOKS: xkcd.com/books', credits text right.
